word:lxx:L700982.explanation: This Greek LXX verb means “push back” or “stop short.” It describes drawing back instead of continuing forward, whether by resisting movement or suddenly holding back. word:lxx:L703132.explanation: This LXX Greek verb means “darken”: to make something dark or to become dark.
